name: Trends agent
job: Reads Google Trends for India in the PC browser: our topics, rising searches, what is trending now.
step: Reading Explore pages (India, 12 months), group 2 of about 7.

did.what: Trending now, India, past 7 days (2,236 trends listed), filtered by ~50 keywords
did.result: In our field only daily-horoscope and festival items: 'ekadashi' 100K+, 'tulsi vivah' 100K+, 'scorpio horoscope today' 10K+, 'मीन राशि' 5K+, 'कन्या राशि' 5K+. Nothing for tarot, numerology, kundli, angel, manifest, chakra.

did.what: Explore: tarot, numerology, rashifal, kundli, mulank (12 months)
did.result: rashifal is by far the biggest (56-100), peak week of 28 Dec 2025; numerology and mulank also peak that week; tarot flat at 16-23.
